welcomeBody: Thanks for joining LocalCooks. Your account is ready.
passwordResetBody: Use the link below to reset your password. It expires soon.
verifyEmailBody: Confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
tourVisitPendingBody: The scheduled tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} has ended. Record whether the kitchen tour took place, the visitor did not attend, or the tour was disrupted. Missing arrival or departure taps do not establish absence.
tourVisitReviewBody: The saved kitchen tour records for {visitor} at {kitchen} need Local Cooks review. Original evidence is preserved. No time or result has been inferred.
tourVisitCorrectedBody: A detail of the kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} was corrected. Open the tour to read the explanation. The appointment and tour result are unchanged.
tourVisitRepairedBody: Local Cooks reviewed the kitchen tour details for {visitor} at {kitchen}. Open the tour to read the explanation. The tour result is unchanged.
tourVisitArrivedBody: Arrival for {visitor} at {kitchen} was recorded. Open the tour to see the saved time.
tourVisitLeftBody: Departure for {visitor} at {kitchen} was recorded. Open the tour to see the saved time.
tourFeedbackRequestedTitle: How did your kitchen tour go?
tourFeedbackRequestedBody: Did your kitchen tour at {kitchen} happen? Tell us how it went and what we could do better.
tourFeedbackManagerRequestedTitle: How did the tour with {visitor} go?
tourFeedbackManagerRequestedBody: Did {visitor}’s tour of {kitchen} take place? Tell us how the visit went and what we could improve.
tourFeedbackMissingBody: At least one tour response is still missing. Follow up with the parties, review the available information and close the tour with an explained result. Missing feedback does not establish visitor absence.
tourFeedbackConflictBody: The tour responses disagree about whether the kitchen tour happened. Review the private responses and record an explained result.
tourFeedbackReadyBody: Both parties have submitted feedback. Review their private responses and record the tour result. Responses do not automatically complete or approve anything.
tourVisitUnknownBody: Local Cooks couldn’t confirm whether the kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} happened. We’ve closed this tour request. Open the tour to read the explanation or contact Support for help.
tourVisitCompletedBody: Local Cooks has confirmed that the kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} took place. Open the tour for the shared notes and next steps. Contact Support if something looks wrong.
tourCompletionApplyBody: Apply when you're ready. Review and edit your application before submitting.
tourCompletionExistingBody: You already have an application or kitchen access. Open the next step to continue or review your current progress.
tourVisitAbsentTitle: The chef didn’t attend the kitchen tour
tourVisitAbsentBody: Local Cooks was told that {visitor} didn’t attend the kitchen tour at {kitchen}. Open the tour for the explanation. Contact Support if something looks wrong.
tourVisitDisruptedTitle: The kitchen tour couldn’t go ahead
tourVisitDisruptedBody: The kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} couldn’t go ahead. Open the tour for the reason and shared notes, or contact Support for help.
tourVisitHistoricalBody: There is a result recorded for the past tour for {visitor} at {kitchen}, but the original kitchen tour information is incomplete. Open the tour or contact Support for help reviewing it.
tourFeedbackPrivacy: Only you and Local Cooks can see your feedback.
tourFeedbackNextStep: Ready to use this kitchen? You can take the next step with your application.
sessionEndingHeading: Your booked time is almost up
sessionEndingBody: Your booked time at {kitchen} ends at {time} ({zone}). When you are finished, open your visit and start check-out. Need more time? Message the kitchen from your visit page.
sessionEndingNote: Leaving early does not refund unused booked time. If something is wrong, use Report a problem or Get help on your visit page.
arrivalModeStaffed: When you arrive, meet kitchen staff and ask for your 6-digit visit code. Enter it in Local Cooks to confirm arrival. The visit code is for the app; it does not open the door.
arrivalModeSelf: Self check-in is on for this visit. Follow the kitchen's instructions to get in, then confirm arrival in Local Cooks. No visit code needed.
arrivalModeMixed: Arrival method varies by visit. Open each visit for details.
arrivalModeLegacy: Follow the arrival instructions and confirm arrival in Local Cooks when you're there.
arrivalActionStaffed: Meet kitchen staff, ask for your visit code, and confirm arrival in Local Cooks.
arrivalActionSelf: Follow the kitchen instructions to get in, then confirm arrival in Local Cooks. No visit code needed.
arrivalActionMixed: Arrival method varies by visit. Open each visit for details.
arrivalActionLegacy: Follow the arrival instructions and confirm arrival in Local Cooks.
instructionsReleaseOverview: Full arrival and departure instructions arrive {releaseAt}, {hours} hours before your visit.
instructionsReleased: Your full arrival and departure instructions are now available below.
visitPreparationSubject: Get ready for your kitchen visit · {kitchen}
visitArrivalInstructionsLink: Arrival instructions: see your preparation email or open your visit.
managerArrivalStaffed: Have the visit code ready and give it to {chef} in person. It is not a door code.
managerArrivalSelf: Self check-in is on. Make sure {chef} can get in and reach you.
managerArrivalLegacy: Make sure {chef} can get in and reach you.
arrivalChangedStaffedSubject: You'll meet kitchen staff for this visit · {kitchen}
arrivalReissuedBody: Meet kitchen staff as planned. If they already gave you a visit code, ask for the current one before confirming arrival.
arrivalTimeUnchanged: Your booked time has not changed.
bookingRefundDestination: To your original card; banks usually take 5–10 business days.
bookingDeadlineOnPage: the response deadline shown on your request
bookingRequestSentBody: {kitchen} has until {deadline} to respond. Your card is on hold and you’re only charged if they accept.
bookingNewRequestBody: Respond by {deadline}. If you don’t, the request expires and the chef’s hold is released.
bookingManagerStaffedBody: Plan who will welcome {chef}. The visit code is on the booking page; give it to the chef in person. It is for Local Cooks and does not open the door.
bookingManagerSelfBody: Self check-in is on for {chef}. Make sure the chef can get in and reach you.
bookingAdminConfirmedBody: Payment is recorded and the booking is confirmed. Open the booking to review the current itinerary.
bookingReleaseOnPage: Open your booking for the instruction release time.
bookingCancellationPolicy: Cancellation: free until {deadline}; after that, cancellation needs kitchen review under your saved {hours}-hour policy. Open the booking to review the applicable refund before cancelling.
bookingChefChanges: Open the booking to request cancellation. For a date/time change, contact {contact}. Your confirmed dates remain in place until a change is agreed.
bookingStaffChanges: Open the booking to review its current status and cancellation requests. Coordinate a date/time change with the booking contact and Local Cooks.
bookingCancelledBody: This kitchen booking has been cancelled. Open your bookings to review the recorded outcome or choose another visit.
bookingSettingsBody: Review the changes below before your next visit. Open the kitchen for its current settings.
bookingAccessRequestBody: {chef} requested access to {kitchen}. Review the application and respond. This request does not reserve kitchen time.
bookingAccessApprovedBody: You can now request available kitchen time. Kitchen access does not reserve a visit; each booking is confirmed separately.
bookingNotificationChangedBody: This address will receive updates for {kitchen}. If you didn’t make this change, contact Local Cooks.
bookingStorageRequestBody: {chef} requested more time for {storage}. Review the new end date and approve or decline the extension.
bookingStoragePaymentBody: Your payment is recorded. The kitchen still needs to approve the extension; keep your current removal date until it is accepted.
bookingStorageApprovedBody: Your extension is approved. Plan removal by the new end date and coordinate with the kitchen.
bookingStorageDeclinedBody: Your extension was declined. Your current removal date remains in place. Open the booking to review the decision and any refund.
bookingOverstayBody: Your storage period has ended. Contact the kitchen to confirm removal or request an extension. Any amount shown is an estimate until a charge is recorded.
bookingPenaltyChargedBody: The storage overstay payment is recorded. Open your storage booking to review the charge and arrange removal if needed.
bookingManagerOverstayBody: Coordinate removal of {storage} with {chef}. Review the current storage record before deciding the next step.
bookingLicenseApprovedBody: Your kitchen licence is approved. Open the kitchen to review availability and listing details.
bookingLicenseRejectedBody: Review the feedback and upload a corrected kitchen licence. Local Cooks will review the new document.
bookingLicenseSubmittedBody: A kitchen licence was submitted. Open the kitchen to review the document and record a decision.
bookingLicenseExpiryBody: Your kitchen licence expires on {expiry}. Upload the renewed licence to keep new bookings available.
bookingManagerMixedBody: Arrival method varies by visit. Plan who will welcome {chef} and open each visit for its arrival details.
bookingManagerLegacyBody: Plan who will welcome {chef}. Review the arrival arrangements and kitchen contact on the booking page.
bookingStorageCheckoutBody: {chef} requested checkout for {storage}. Inspect the storage and confirm physical removal before approving clearance.
bookingStorageClaimBody: The kitchen filed a claim after inspecting your storage. Review the claim and respond from your dashboard. A claim does not prove a charge or physical removal.
bookingRequestPendingBody: {kitchen} received your request. Your kitchen time is not confirmed. Open your request for the current payment status and next steps.
bookingRequestPaidBody: Your payment is recorded, and {kitchen} still needs to accept the request. Open the request for its current status and next steps.
bookingNewRequestPendingBody: Review this request and respond to the chef. The booking is not confirmed; open it for the current payment status.
bookingClaimChargedBody: Your claim payment is recorded. Open the claim to review the outcome and payment record.
